findingsWithIssues.title: Orders with missing/invalid table linkage
findingsWithIssues.impact: Table QR flow inconsistent; kitchen display may show wrong table.
findingsWithIssues.cleanup: Fix tableId or delete invalid orders.

findingsWithIssues.title: Order items orphan (order or menu item missing)
findingsWithIssues.impact: Order totals and line items inconsistent.
findingsWithIssues.cleanup: Delete orphan order_items or restore parent order/menu item.

findingsAll.title: Orphan subscriptions (missing user or restaurant)
findingsAll.impact: Subscription rows detached from owners or venues; billing and ordering resolution may fail.
findingsAll.cleanup: Delete orphan subscription rows after confirming no payment history, or re-link to valid user/restaurant.

findingsAll.title: Subscriptions with invalid planId
findingsAll.impact: Plan features and pricing undefined; admin and ordering checks may deny access.
findingsAll.cleanup: Update planId to valid plan or delete orphan subscription rows.

findingsAll.title: Duplicate active/trial per (userId, restaurantId)
findingsAll.impact: Canonical resolver must pick one row; historical bulk updates may have affected wrong row pre-LH-1B-4.
findingsAll.cleanup: Merge or cancel duplicate rows; keep one entitled row per (userId, restaurantId); add unique index in later migration.

findingsAll.title: Expired active subscriptions (period end in past)
findingsAll.impact: Post-LH-1B-3 entitlement denies features; row still shows active in DB and admin stats.
findingsAll.cleanup: Set status to expired or extend period after payment verification.

findingsAll.title: Expired or missing trial end
findingsAll.impact: Trial features blocked by entitlement layer while status remains trial.
findingsAll.cleanup: Expire trial rows or set valid trialEndsAt.

findingsAll.title: Subscription userId ظëب restaurant owner
findingsAll.impact: Wrong owner billed or entitled for a venue.
findingsAll.cleanup: Correct userId to restaurant owner or move subscription to correct restaurantId.

findingsAll.title: Orphan invoices (user or subscription missing)
findingsAll.impact: Billing artifacts reference deleted entities; PDF and admin views may break.
findingsAll.cleanup: Delete orphan invoices or restore parent user/subscription.

findingsAll.title: Restaurants without owner user
findingsAll.impact: Orphan venues cannot authenticate or manage menus.
findingsAll.cleanup: Delete restaurant cascade or assign valid userId.

findingsAll.title: Duplicate restaurant slugs
findingsAll.impact: Public menu URLs may resolve to wrong restaurant.
findingsAll.cleanup: Rename duplicate slugs; enforce unique constraint if missing.

findingsAll.title: Restaurants with no subscription row for owner
findingsAll.impact: Venue may lack trial/paid access; ordering and premium features blocked.
findingsAll.cleanup: Create scoped or user-level trial subscription for owner.

findingsAll.title: Orders without restaurant
findingsAll.impact: Orphan orders invisible in restaurant dashboards.
findingsAll.cleanup: Delete orphan orders and order_items.

findingsAll.title: Orders with missing/invalid table linkage
findingsAll.impact: Table QR flow inconsistent; kitchen display may show wrong table.
findingsAll.cleanup: Fix tableId or delete invalid orders.

findingsAll.title: Order items orphan (order or menu item missing)
findingsAll.impact: Order totals and line items inconsistent.
findingsAll.cleanup: Delete orphan order_items or restore parent order/menu item.

findingsAll.title: Order totalAmount mismatch vs line items
findingsAll.impact: Financial and ops reports wrong; possible pre-LH-1A client-priced orders.
findingsAll.cleanup: Recalculate totalAmount from order_items for affected orders.

findingsAll.title: Categories without restaurant
findingsAll.impact: Menu structure broken for public pages.
findingsAll.cleanup: Delete orphan categories and dependent items.

findingsAll.title: Menu items without restaurant or category
findingsAll.impact: Ordering and menu display fail for affected items.
findingsAll.cleanup: Delete orphan menu items or restore parents.

findingsAll.title: Menu item restaurantId ظëب category restaurantId
findingsAll.impact: Cross-venue menu leakage or order validation errors.
findingsAll.cleanup: Align restaurantId on item or move to correct category.

findingsAll.title: Duplicate normalized emails
findingsAll.impact: Migration 0019 unique email may fail; auth identity confusion.
findingsAll.cleanup: Merge or reassign duplicate accounts before unique index enforcement.

findingsAll.title: Duplicate openId
findingsAll.impact: OAuth/session may attach to wrong user.
findingsAll.cleanup: Deduplicate users and fix openId values.

findingsAll.title: Legacy Manus login artifacts
findingsAll.impact: Legacy provider users may need migration to email/OAuth policy.
findingsAll.cleanup: Review accounts; migrate to supported loginMethod if still active.

findingsAll.title: Localhost upload URLs in production data
findingsAll.impact: Broken images/PDFs in production menus and invoices.
findingsAll.cleanup: Re-upload assets to R2; update URL columns.

findingsAll.title: Users missing createdAt or updatedAt
findingsAll.impact: Audit trails incomplete.
findingsAll.cleanup: Backfill timestamps from related records.
